title: 低位捏点平衡
description: 粉彩表现宽捏点上的双手与低脚点的对角平衡。

art_direction.medium: soft pastel drawing with clear contour accents
art_direction.scene: An original pastel illustration shows a fictional fully clothed adult balancing between two broad pinch holds on a low near-vertical bouldering wall. The thumb and fingers naturally oppose around the large hold faces, and both feet stand on clear positive footholds with a modest diagonal stance. The torso turns slightly to prepare a short next movement while remaining only a small step above the continuous crash mat. Frame the whole figure in a frontal medium-wide view, leaving generous empty landing space. Use soft dusty rose, deep teal, and chalky cream marks. Avoid tiny fingertip grips, extreme strain, jumps, lettering, brands, photographic skin, and high exposure.
